messages.subject: Rankings Available for Proposals?
parts:
Dear R GSoC Maintainers

I was wondering if the rankings of the projects is available now as I see that the rankings were due yesterday.

https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2025/wiki

I have had quite a few students reach out regarding my proposals (sundialr and r2sbml), but I am hesitant to engage with them without know if my proposals are accepted or not.

I would be thankful if the results of the proposals are posted soon.

Thank you!
Satyaprakash
